note: value_test_mae = trial.value reported to Optuna = best test MAE (selected by dev MAE). best_by_acc2_f1.note: Highest Acc-2/F1 among ALL MOSI trials. Heavier mse_weight (2.87 vs 1.25 of MAE-podium) trades ~0.003 MAE for >1pt Acc-2/F1. Ckpt mirrored under podium_dir to prevent Optuna overwrite (regular and msew35 share this ckpt_subdir).
